title: Present Continuous: ESTAR + Gerund
summary: Describe actions happening right now with estou falando, está comendo, and estão abrindo.

sections.heading: Forming the gerund
sections.body:
Use **estar** in the present plus the gerund. Gerunds usually end in **-ando** for -ar verbs and **-endo/-indo** for -er/-ir verbs.

| Subject | falar | comer | abrir |
|---|---|---|---|
| eu | **estou falando** | **estou comendo** | **estou abrindo** |
| você/ele/ela | **está falando** | **está comendo** | **está abrindo** |
| nós | **estamos falando** | **estamos comendo** | **estamos abrindo** |
| vocês/eles/elas | **estão falando** | **estão comendo** | **estão abrindo** |

sections.heading: When to use it
sections.body: Use **estar + gerúndio** for actions in progress at the moment or around the current period. Do not overuse it for general habits; the simple present often works better.

examples.pt: Estou lendo um livro muito bom.
examples.en: I am reading a very good book.
We are looking for an apartment.

sections.heading: Spoken contractions
sections.body: In conversation, **estou** and **está** are often pronounced and written informally as **tô** and **tá**. Use full forms in standard writing.

keyPoints: Use it for actions in progress, not every future or habit.
Tô and tá are common informal contractions.

commonMistakes.wrong: Eu estou morando no Brasil desde 2020.
commonMistakes.note: For stable residence, simple present is often more natural.
